meta.name: create-apple-notes-mockup
meta.description: Render pixel-accurate Apple Notes (iPhone, light mode) screenshot mockups from a JSON note spec. Outputs HTML + PNG at the iPhone 16/15 Pro native 1180×2556. Supports paragraphs, images, checklists, dividers, autocorrect underline, smart quotes, and an optional iOS keyboard chrome overlay used by the parent video-ad molecule.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 JSON 生成像素级精确的苹果备忘录截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为演示或广告生成逼真的 iPhone 备忘录截图
copy.tagline_en: Generate pixel-accurate Apple Notes mockups from JSON
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need realistic iPhone Notes screenshots for demos or ads

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以根据你提供的笔记内容，生成一张看起来像 iPhone 上 Apple Notes 应用截图的图片（HTML 和 PNG 格式），包含标题、正文、图片、待办清单、分隔线、自动纠错下划线、光标和键盘等元素。
howto.when: 当你需要一张假的 Apple Notes 截图用于广告、社交媒体、视频场景或产品原型时触发。也用于生成一系列帧来驱动打字动画视频。

say.text: 生成一张 Apple Notes 截图，标题是“购物清单”，正文包含牛奶和面包。
say.note: 会输出一张包含标题和段落的笔记截图。

say.text: 创建一个带待办清单的笔记截图，第一项已勾选，第二项未勾选。
say.note: 会生成包含勾选和未勾选项的清单。

say.text: 生成一张带键盘的笔记截图，标题为“提醒”，正文为空。
say.note: 会输出一张显示键盘的笔记截图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a screenshot mockup of Apple Notes on iPhone (light mode) as HTML and PNG, based on a JSON note spec. It supports paragraphs, images, checklists, dividers, autocorrect underline, cursor, and optional keyboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a fake Apple Notes screenshot for ads, social posts, video scenes, or product mockups. Also used to generate frames for typing animation videos.

say_en.text: Generate an Apple Notes screenshot with title 'Shopping List' and body containing milk and bread.
say_en.note: Outputs a note screenshot with title and paragraphs.

say_en.text: Create a note screenshot with a checklist where the first item is checked and the second unchecked.
say_en.note: Generates a screenshot with checked and unchecked items.

say_en.text: Generate a note screenshot with keyboard, title 'Reminder', and empty body.
say_en.note: Outputs a note screenshot showing the keyboard.
